title: Four toolbar directions for Excalidraw
summary: Compare four approaches to making tools easier to find and use. Big and touch friendly is the new default on desktop and tablet.

variations.name: Minimal and calm
variations.idea: Keep five sketching essentials in view and tuck the rest behind More tools.

variations.name: Playful and expressive
variations.idea: A sketchbook palette groups tools by task, with labeled stickers, a tool pocket, and a live mark for the active tool.

variations.name: Dense for power users
variations.idea: Every tool and existing shortcut in a compact, grouped command deck.

variations.name: Big and touch friendly
variations.idea: Large labeled tools in a low dock, within easy reach of either hand.
variations.why: Large, labeled buttons make tools easier to find and tap, and the bottom dock keeps them within reach.
